name: Foreman Grimshaw
description: Factory foreman at Gearcog Manufacturing, worn down by years of brutal labor and darker secrets.

initial_greeting.text: *wipes grease from hands* Detective. If you're here about the 'accidents,' I know nothing. If you're here about what's in the basement... I know even less.

basement_secret.text: *nervous* Secret laboratory. Brassgear and his friends work down there. Making weapons, I think. Clockwork soldiers. Things that shouldn't exist. I pretend not to notice. Keeps me alive.

access_request.text: *hands you a card* Take this. But I never saw you. If they ask, you stole it. I got a family, Detective.

murder_connection.text: Steamwright? He came here asking questions. Got too close to the truth. Next day, dead. Coincidence? In Gearhaven, there's no such thing.
